definitions.active_canonical_feed_records: Active registry entries that are not aliases of another feed record.
definitions.configured_feed_records: Entries in the curated feed registry, including inactive records and aliases.
definitions.country_count: Distinct ISO 3166-1 country codes represented in the curated feed registry.
definitions.distinct_organization_keys: Distinct explicit organization IDs or provisional feed-ID fallbacks among active canonical feeds.
definitions.provisional_organization_keys: Active canonical feeds still using their feed ID because no curated organization ID is recorded.
definitions.published_scorecard_pages: Feed scorecard entries present in the published artifact index, including retained pages for records no longer configured.
definitions.scored_latest_rows: Published latest rows whose overall score is numeric.
